protocol.status: Declared before selecting the episode; descriptive Q2 execution example only

selection.rule: Among the original assigned OOF client-C annual-policy rows, sort by descending saved annual MDD and then ascending scenario ID. Select the first row, without searching for a favorable alternative-policy example.
selection.scope: One complete development scenario in its original 24-path evaluation fold; do not mix in full-development targets or fit any new target.

comparisons: annual_restore with that fold's original assigned target
initial_then_hold with exactly the same target
finite_horizon_gate at mesh .05, separately simulated for H=30, with exactly the same target
Exact-thirds annual reference if its saved complete execution artifact exists; label its different target as a reference, not a pure execution ablation
protocol.artifact_scope: Read only saved original OOF rows, recorded fold menus and completed fixed-execution/finite-horizon artifacts. Do not load market CSV, final paths121–180, refit models or add a nested-target example.
protocol.metrics: Actual saved net real wealth at years0..30, annual-endpoint drawdown/MDD, annual end weights, TV drift from each policy's own fixed target, actual transferred nominal amount, actual nominal fee, trade flag and labeled return years.
protocol.timing: Fee/transfer for return year t is paid at that year's start, before its annual return; the initial trade is before return year1. Annual wealth at t is the saved year-end point. No fee checkpoints or unknown intrayear price observations are inserted.

episode.trough: First annual index attaining the annual policy's maximum drawdown
episode.peak: First annual index attaining the highest saved annual wealth through that trough
episode.recovery: First year after the trough at which annual real wealth returns to that preceding peak, using only a 1e-10 wealth-unit numerical equality guard; otherwise unrecovered by year30
episode.other_policies: Record their full-path MDD and their drawdown/wealth at the same annual peak/trough dates, separately from their own worst episode.

outputs: Year-by-year CSV including actual fees, transfers, weights and drawdown
One readable research PNG/SVG with consistent policy colors and explicit episode-selection bias
Source/input/output SHA and exact reconciliation checks
protocol.limitations: Selection deliberately emphasizes the original annual policy's most severe OOF path. This example cannot rank overall strategy quality, establish causal market drivers, certify risk or represent a typical investor. No model or winner is selected.

panels: Actual nominal fees and trade years
